requests.prompt: Editorial still-life photograph, warm paper aesthetic, horizontal 16:9. Four sequential stages of making one simple physical object from ceramic and matte metal, laid out in a clear left-to-right row on a warm cream-paper backdrop with even spacing: first raw clay and a rough blank form, second a shaped and smoothed form, third a refined matte metal and ceramic assembly with polished copper joints, fourth the finished simple object. Soft natural side light, plenty of air, quiet and orderly. Muted palette: milky cream, warm off-white, graphite grey, matte copper, subtle terracotta. Premium magazine photography, natural color, no text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no UI, no screens, no robots, no neon.
